scope_audit.miscdevice: Complete actual kernel include; dynamic minor, initial misc private_data, reader replacement and current-sequence open baseline explained.
scope_audit.abi: Exact decimal sequence + space + LED0/1 + newline, no NUL. Accepted-press counter per device lifetime, practically monotonic u64 with explicit wrap/reset. Independent opens versus shared file descriptions; mutex serialization; coalesced latest state rather than queue. Software LED state can lead GPIO write.
scope_audit.read_poll_errors: Zero-sized read immediate zero including offline; nonzero offline ENODEV at state check with in-flight race qualified. EAGAIN with no new sequence; EINVAL only after available record and no seen update; EFAULT no consumption with partial user-memory modification qualified. Signal interruption/restart; poll ready and ERR/HUP; no consumption/reservation by poll. Explicitly qualifies that O_NONBLOCK can still wait for the per-open reader mutex held across another active read/event wait; exercises use one active read caller per open.
scope_audit.client: Complete actual client include, Pi native build, 1..1000 successful-read count, O_NONBLOCK plus sleeping poll, fresh 30s timeout per call and EINTR retry, error paths, prints bytes without ABI validation.
scope_audit.permissions: Actual complete rule include, existing real gpio group prerequisite and deliberate policy, conditional membership/relogin, scoped sysfs trigger after reload, no world-write, existing rule collision check.
scope_audit.practical: Future-press instructions, held-button release, illustrative non-initial counters, foreground cleanup, bounded Python stdlib blocking read and nonblocking EAGAIN/shortbuffer same-open retry, no fabricated binary. Same-open short-buffer retry described as demonstrating expected contract under single-event condition, not proving no consumption in the presence of a fresh press/bounce.
scope_audit.progression: Read current 8.4; same bound 8.3 module/circuit retained; Pico unplugged and bus/debug wires absent; no userspace GPIO requests while kernel owns lines; manual load/binding after reboot, persistent overlay/no autoload; idle clients for 8.6.
